subject: What to do for missing GCPO ?

messages.author: 9a5b747b943f32d3
messages.subject: What to do for missing GCPO ?
parts:
Hi, 

I noticed that sometimes GCPO values can be missing while CPO values are ok (not missing and not failure).

For example, this behavior just arose when I changed the likelihood from Binomial to a Betabinomial. For both models, I used the following control options  (R4.3.1 and testing version as of yesterday):
list(
          strategy = "laplace",
          int.strategy = "grid",
          compute.initial.values = T,
          cmin = -Inf,
          optimise.strategy = "plain",
          fast = FALSE,
          hessian.correct.skewness.only = FALSE,
          linear.correction = T,
          restart = 0L,
          stencil = 9,
          dz = 0.05,
          diff.logdens = 1,
          npoints = 3000
        )

I also encountered the same issues in other cases when using specific graphs or combination of latent models. 

Because CPO are ok, I assume that sometimes INLA has trouble creating the groups for computing the GCPO? I haven't found a way to recompute one-by-one the missing GCPO, similar to inla.cpo, is there any that I have missed?
 
Best,
Olivier
